[[Antoni Zygmund]] wrote a classic two-volume set of books entitled '''''Trigonometric Series''''', which discusses many different aspects of [[trigonometric series]]. The first edition was a single volume, published in 1935 (under the slightly different title ''Trigonometrical Series''). The second edition of 1959 was greatly expanded, taking up two volumes, though it was later reprinted as a single volume paperback. The third edition of 2002 is similar to the second edition, with the addition of a preface by Robert A. Fefferman on more recent developments, in particular [[Carleson's theorem]] about [[pointwise convergence#Almost everywhere convergence|almost everywhere pointwise convergence]] for [[square-integrable functions]].{{Citation needed|date=June 2021}}
